description: BCA Coverage Index: a recency-weighted count of BCA article mentions of the entity over 7d, 30d or 90d, recomputed every 4 hours. Unseeded when the entity had no mentions in the window. Pro tier. meta.status is unseeded when there is no measurement yet (data.value is then a placeholder), partial when some inputs were defaulted (meta.diagnostic.missing) and stale when the newest value is over 48 hours old. An unknown entity is an error (HTTP 404).
name: get_coverage_index
